quest.title: Covert Investigation, Dirty Money Misdeeds
quest.description: The time to act is almost upon you. It's time to head to Yilong Wharf and meet up with Yelan...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Well done, you two. Right on time.

choices.text: How's the case coming along?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The day after we infiltrated the storage facility, the Dark Financier's two lackeys, Corder and Doddamani, started moving the goods.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: See that ship? It's the one Doddamani dispatched to transport the goods. It operates under the guise of a joint passenger and freight vessel.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, that's one huge boat! Paimon can see all the goods piled up on the pier! Seems like it's transporting quite a few passengers to Lumidouce Harbor as well...

choices.text: What if those aren't the real goods, though?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Thinking two-steps ahead? I like it. You're a fast learner.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: If Corder and Doddamani think the authorities are on to them, it's possible the goods they're sending to Lumidouce Harbor are a whole bunch of nothing. Just bait to flush out the law enforcement on their tail.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: But we need to be careful. Several members of the crew have confessed that a veteran Treasure Hoarder known as "Scamface" is involved with the Dark Financier.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: As an escaped convict, Scamface is a master of staying hidden. Based on our earlier investigation, it's clear he's the one who's been doing reconnaissance on the Millelith's lighthouse.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I'll circle the area to draw Scamface's attention away from the scene while you two inspect the goods.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Remember to keep a low profile.

choices.text: Understood. I'll keep it stealthy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah! And Paimon will do her best to... float closer to the ground! No higher than {NICKNAME}'s shoulder!

choices.text: Don't worry. I've got this.
Should we investigate them just in case?
Any developments?

talks.objective: Equip the item and talk to Yelan

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready to go.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Alright, we'll meet back up here once you're done.

talks.objective: Investigate the goods on the pier

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, that's all the bombs on the deck. What about the cargo hold? Do we have enough time?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Already taken care of.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Good work, you two. You stayed calm and acted fast. That was the perfect response to a situation like this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yelan! Honestly, it's all thanks to you. It was your idea to board the ship. And, we never would've been able to figure out that message without your cipher...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a sec... Where are Corder and Doddamani?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Heh...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Recovering from the shock, I would imagine. Suddenly finding out that you're being targeted by a dangerous individual... That must have been quite the ordeal for you, gentlemen? Almost lost your cargo and your lives in one fell swoop...

dialogues.speaker: Corder
dialogues.text: Indeed. To think such evil exists in this world... I can scarcely imagine what I did to offend this fellow. Resorting to murder like this... It's quite unfathomable.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Well, no need to fear. I'll alert the Maison Gardiennage at once and ask them to send agents to Lumidouce Harbor. The two of you are clearly in need of protection.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Your cargo will also need to be handed over to the authorities for inspection, Mr. Corder — just to eliminate any remaining hazards. After which, the Maison Gardiennage will escort it all to its intended destination, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: So, if I may... Where are your goods heading, Mr. Corder?

dialogues.speaker: Corder
dialogues.text: ...To the Hotel Debord. For an auction in two days.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Ah, then rest assured. The Maison Gardiennage is full of diligent and responsible personnel. You can trust that your goods will arrive at the auction without a scratch.

dialogues.speaker: Corder
dialogues.text: Our sincerest thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After some time, the ship safely docks at Lumidouce Harbor. The Maison Gardiennage conduct a quick safety inspection and unload all the cargo from the ship.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: In the meantime, you tell Yelan about the note Scamface left for Corder and Doddamani.

talks.objective: Summarize the results of your investigation

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, so no fakes. These people are definitely anxious to get their goods to Fontaine all in one go...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But did you see the strange markings on some of them? Wonder what they mean... Let's go ask Yelan!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You find Yelan and tell her the results of the investigation...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Good work. As for the auction, Officer Edler was able to gather some useful intel too. We're almost certain their target is the auction taking place at the Hotel Debord in two days.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The markings you managed to capture were applied with a special kind of paint. Almost impossible to notice without some kind of specialized tech, like the Forensic Imaging Device.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I think we're looking at a Treasure Hoarder insignia. Each big shot in the organization has their own — almost like a personal signature. And considering what we know about the case, I'd wager this is Scamface's handiwork.

choices.text: So... He's labeling the goods. But why?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Based on the port manifest, it looks like the marked goods include... fertilizer from Sumeru, local fireworks, soap, and perfume.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So nothing special then... Just some farming products and everyday necessities?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Fertilizer, soap, and perfume... No, there's something going on there.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Might be risky, but I'm gonna investigate on board, and hitch a ride to Fontaine while I'm at it.

choices.text: We've made it this far...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, let's see this thing through! Paimon's gotta know what's going on here!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Well, you've proved yourselves so far, so I don't see a problem with that. Just know, once we board the ship, we're bound to come face to face with Corder and Doddamani.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: So, make sure you're prepared. The investigation might look a little different this time.

choices.text: We'll come with you.
What message is he trying to send?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Yelan's distraction is holding. This is our chance, but we need to hurry.)

dialogues.speaker: Crewmember
dialogues.text: Excuse me, passengers. Due to limited space in the cargo hold, we've been forced to store some of the goods on the deck. We apologize for the inconvenience.

dialogues.speaker: Friendly Passenger
dialogues.text: Ah please, no need to apologize for your success in business! I just hope it rubs off on the rest of us! Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It looks like all the goods marked with Scamface's insignia have Corder listed as the shipper. Doddamani is in the cargo hold, likely making sure all the goods are in place for delivery.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are they... inspecting something? Why are they rifling through the boxes? Paimon can't make sense of it!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Here, take this cipher. It should help you figure out their coded messages.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: This is the plan — while I distract Corder and Doddamani, you two investigate the goods marked with Scamface's insignia. We might learn something useful.

choices.text: If I find something concerning...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: By all means. I trust your judgement.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? W—W—Wait! You're just gonna go up and talk to those guys!? Yelan!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Hm? Oh, excuse me gentlemen, but... Have we met?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You're Mr. Corder, a famous antique collector in the Quartier Lyonnais, correct? I believe the three of us have had the pleasure of meeting once before. At Jiulue Teahouse in Yilong Wharf, if I'm not mistaken...

response.speaker: Doddamani
response.text: Huh? You... You!

response.speaker: Corder
response.text: ...Ah, the Dice Master of Yanshang Teahouse... It's a pleasure, Miss Yelan.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Oh, so you've heard of me too?

response.speaker: Corder
response.text: Yes, I had an absolutely delectable cup of tea there once. One can hardly leave Yanshang Teahouse without hearing about your legendary dice skills. I suppose something keeps bringing us together. A shared love of tea, perhaps?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Yes, that must be it... Well, looks like we ran into each other at the perfect time. I'm heading to Fontaine on vacation, you see. Any recommendations on where I should visit?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Someplace I could find an exquisite tea set, perhaps... Like a fine art exhibition. Or, an auction? I hear Fontainian black tea has a unique flavor. I imagine your tea sets are a sight to behold as well.

response.speaker: Doddamani
response.text: You—!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Ah, does this gentleman have an interest in tea sets as well?

response.speaker: Doddamani
response.text: I... Ahem... Of course. It's a pleasure to meet you, Miss Yelan. I'm also heading to Fontaine for travel. Corder's invitation, you see. In fact, I'm the one who owns this ship...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, Yelan is actually talking to them! Are we sure that's a good idea...?

choices.text: We don't have much time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright! Then, let's go somewhere out of their line of sight so we can start investigating those boxes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *coughing* What's with the strong smell coming from these boxes? Must be a bunch of stuff mixed together...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And there's a strange note. But, Paimon can't read what it says...

choices.text: It's written in code...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yelan really thinks of everything, huh! But, uh... You know how to use this thing, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well? Well? What does it say?

choices.text: If I'm right, they're planning to dispose of the goods...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: B—B—B—Blowing up the ship!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are they nuts? Paimon thought this was about getting the authorities off their tails... Not drawing even more attention!

choices.text: Scamface needs to protect the person at the top...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, Yelan was right! This guy is a complete lunatic!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There are innocent people on this ship! We need to find and disarm those bombs as soon as possible!

choices.text: So, he's diverting attention to an ever bigger problem...
And cutting off all our leads in the process...
...By blowing up the ship.
Luckily, we have the cipher...
She's giving us an opening! Let's use it!
Is it okay if I deal with it right then and there?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's act now!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Alright, remember to equip the <color=#00E1FFFF>Forensic Imaging Device</color> and try not to make too much noise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you scared the life out of Paimon, Yelan! Going right up to them like that... What if they caught on and decided to, you know... try something desperate!?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It's not a question of "if," Paimon. I'm sure they caught on, but in the interest of their own survival, they had no choice but to play along.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Now, we can be sure the Dark Financier is getting desperate. The stint on the ship, that was him trying to cut his losses to save his own skin.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: He needs to get rid of anything that could be traced back to him. So, you blow up the ship. You send the goods meant for the auction straight to the bottom of the sea, and let Scamface take the heat...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The last thing he wanted was for the goods to make it to the auction. But, now, we've ensured that they will. So, he has no choice but to follow through.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: He could choose not to send one of his agents to the auction, and let his goods go to an unsuspecting buyer instead. But remember, their worth is inflated...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It would only be a matter of time before the buyer realized the valuation was off and reported it to the authorities. As the seller, Corder would be staring down a potential conviction.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: At best, the Dark Financier has to find a new kind of Mora-laundering scheme. At worst, he loses one of his last reliable agents in Fontaine.

choices.text: And, if he does decide to continue with the auction...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Exactly. Our trail of evidence remains intact, and we let the buyer at the auction lead us closer to the Dark Financier.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, um... So, uh... That means, um... Could we go over this again?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: #Don't worry. I'm sure {NICKNAME} will explain it again in Paimon-friendly language.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: We're in the home stretch, and taking advantage of this auction is crucial... So, come prepared to see this through.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Officer Edler already has an informant stationed at the scene. This invitation letter will get you in to the auction.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I'll meet you at the Hotel Debord in two days.

choices.text: That also works in our favor...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: All set?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hold on, let me check!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I should equip the <color=#00E1FFFF>Forensic Imaging Device</color>...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me just check something first...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Yelan is turning the heat up on your opponent — now is the time to focus on dismantling the bomb...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'll keep an eye on the perimeter and make sure Scamface doesn't get close...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Of course, if he knows I'm here, there's no way he'll risk showing his face.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Take this opportunity to collect evidence. Check the goods carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You arrive at the pier and begin your investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: In the meantime, you tell Yelan about the note Scamface left for Corder and Doddamani.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it's been two days! Let's go meet up with Yelan!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, Paimon's getting excited! Searching for evidence, tracking down a crime boss... It's like being a real detective!
